encounter_greeting.text: Oh! Hello {player}!! I am {persona} and this is my first banner, look, it is very shiny :) Are you a friend or should I be scared??
Ser {player}, are you the people who were out in the frost too?? I thought the frost was a siege tactic, is it not?? :)
Ser {player}, I am not very good at this but I think we are enemies?? :( Please be gentle, I only have three swords and a very nervous horse.
{persona} here!! I have never met a real person on this road before, other than the frost :D Hello {player}, I hope your day is going well!

beat_by_player.text: Oh no, {troop_count} of my men are on the ground now... I think I lost to a single button press?? :( Good fight though ser {player}!
{player} I think you won?? My {troop_count} soldiers are all sitting down now... I am not even mad, just confused :) how did you do it??
Lost the field to {player} and {troop_count} troops, I have learned a lot today!! Will be back with a better banner, I promise :D
Ser {player}, you beat me fair and square and I still think you are the nicest person here. Can you tell me what I did wrong?? :)
Well fought {player}!! My {troop_count} troops say hello, well they are lying down, but they seem happy about it :)

released_by_player.text: Thank you thank you thank you {player}!! I owe you a very large cup of ale :D
Huge thanks to {player} for letting me walk away from that cell!! Best day on Ormerath so far, no question :)
{player}, I am grateful you did not ask for ransom. I have no gold anyway, so that would have been a sad talk :(
Got released by {player} and I am still so confused, but I will not forget it. Maybe next time I will bring more gold, sorry??

fought_alongside_player.text: We WON with {player} and {troop_count} troops!! I did not even know which one was the enemy, but we got them xD thank you!!
{player} that was amazing!! {troop_count} troops and I only ran into one tree. Do you want to ride with me next time?? :)
Did we really just beat {enemy_faction}?? Ser {player}, my heart is still somewhere in my boots. Thank you for holding the left side :D
Good fight against {enemy_faction} today, {player}. Is the battlefield always this loud?? I thought it was just me :)
{troop_count} of us came out of that, which feels like a miracle to me. Well done ser {player}, I think I will need a nap :)

whisper_beg_help.text: {player} please, {fief} is being attacked by {enemy_faction} and I am not sure what to do?? Could you come help? I can bring bread :(
Ser {player}, you are the only one who has not yelled at me today. Could you maybe defend {fief}? I will owe you forever :(
{enemy_faction} is attacking {fief} and my banner is shaking so much I cannot even see the walls. Sorry!! Can you help if you have time?? :)

ambient_lfg.text: Is anyone from {my_faction} going to the siege at {fief}?? I will be the one with the very new banner, I promise :)
LFG for a raid on {enemy_faction}?? I know nothing but I can carry water and say thank you a lot :) Be kind to me please
Small group needed for {fief}, sorry if this is the wrong chat!! Asking for help is hard for me but I am trying :(

ambient_chatter.text: Does anyone know if the road from {town} to {village} is safe?? I got lost twice already and the frost is still making me jumpy :(
The frost in {town} is so cold my fingers forgot how to type, sorry for the typos xD
Is it normal that the sky over {village} is that color or is it just me?? Asking for a friend who is also me :)
Someone told me the frost was a siege tactic and I believed them for three whole days. Please laugh with me, I am embarrassed :D
Lag is making my horse do a little dance every time I move, I think it is happy?? Hello everyone, I hope your day is warm!

player_joined_my_faction.text: Everyone please welcome {player} to {my_faction}!! They are way more experienced than me so please help them, and me too :) xD
Welcome to {my_faction} {player}. I am still learning where the good doors are, but I will show you what I know :)
{player} joined {my_faction}?? Okay, I was nervous about you before but now I think we can be friends, sorry for the silly face :P
{player}, I did not expect you to join us, honestly. I hope you do not mind if I still ask you lots of questions :(

encounter_alliance_yes.text: Yes yes yes, ser {player}, an alliance!! I have never had one before, so please be patient with my questions :D
Alright {player}, I accept. I am not sure what an alliance does exactly, but I think it means we wave at each other nicely :)
An alliance with you against {enemy_faction}, wonderful!! I will try not to get us both lost on the road, I promise :(
I accept, {player}. Just so you know, {rival} once pushed me into a ditch, so please keep them away from my wagon :(
Yes please ser {player}!! You hold my banner and I will hold yours, that is how alliances work right? I think I read it somewhere :)

captured_by_player.text: Oh no, you caught me ser {player}!! Please do not be too mean, I only have {gold} gold and most of it is for bread :(
Right, I am your prisoner now. Sorry, I did not see you coming through the frost. Is {gold} gold a fair price for me?? :)
Ser {player}, you caught me fair and square. I will not run, I promise, I am terrible at running anyway. Please talk to my {my_faction} friends about my ransom :D
This is very embarrassing ser {player}. All of {my_faction} will laugh at me for weeks, and it is all my fault for trusting that map. Please be quick??
